title: OL08-04A Credential Disposition State and Evidence Foundation

permissions.reason: Closure credential disposition is a destructive-security lifecycle operation and remains under the existing Core SYSTEM-only organization delete authority; no organization-role permission is added.

items.action: start, inspect, retry and reconcile credential disposition evidence for an organization closure execution

frontend.reason: OL08-04A exposes SYSTEM-only credential disposition metadata/evidence endpoints; no UI or customer-facing workflow is added.

ui_permissions.reason: No UI authorization surface is added.

notes: Bounded OL08-04A only. Starting disposition requires SYSTEM authority plus a live Core SUSPENDED snapshot, disables outbound email-account use without soft-deleting the account, and records per-account durable non-secret capability/evidence state. Generic SMTP reusable passwords are operator_required and are zeroized only after explicit external invalidation evidence. MailerSend API tokens are classified supported_unidentifiable on the current model; target metadata may be recorded only as unverified and cannot be operator-overridden into success, so no arbitrary token deletion occurs. Webhook signing secrets may remain receive_only_pending and final time-based purge is not implemented. No closure package, not_required export success, product-data/artifact deletion, retention/grace duration, backup policy, cleanup_complete/ready_for_tombstone, or Core tombstone is added.
